summary: Implementation plan for Wear OS 5.0 ANCS Bridge v4: Fix Contact Name vs Phone Number extraction and Data Source 0x03 command structure, remove Scan Beacon B, and redesign the watch interface into a 2-page horizontal swipe experience (Page 1: Digital Clock, Missed Call counter, Message counter, and Clear button; Page 2: Mode A Advertise, Re-Sync, Test Alert, Raw Attribute inspector, and Live Telemetry).
